why_not_counted_as_a_strict_discovery: Predicted structures are scientifically useful but a prediction database is not itself a catalog of experimentally confirmed discoveries; individual downstream discoveries should be registered separately.
revisit_condition: Add specific downstream biological discoveries when their empirical evidence and AI contribution are traceable.

claim_or_system: Coscientist planned and executed cross-coupling reactions

revisit_condition: Count only a later novel reaction, mechanism, or compound with explicit experimental novelty analysis.

claim_or_system: Transformer-designed quantum experiments and state generalizations
why_not_counted_as_a_strict_discovery: The system produced computational experiment designs and generalizations, but no corresponding laboratory discovery was established in the reviewed source.
revisit_condition: Add to a separate theoretical/design tier or after physical realization.

claim_or_system: Diagnostic classifiers, protein-property predictors, weather and climate forecasters
why_not_counted_as_a_strict_discovery: Better prediction of a known label or future value is not a discovery unless the work also establishes a new object, mechanism, relationship, candidate, or law.
revisit_condition: Evaluate individual studies when they make and validate a genuinely novel scientific claim.
